package nav2d // import "github.com/TimLai666/coimnet/experiment/nav2d"

type Config struct {
	Width            int     `json:"width"`
	Height           int     `json:"height"`
	WallDensity      float64 `json:"wall_density"`
	ViewDepth        int     `json:"view_depth"`
	TimeLimit        int     `json:"time_limit"`
	StepPenalty      float64 `json:"step_penalty"`
	CollisionPenalty float64 `json:"collision_penalty"`
	GoalReward       float64 `json:"goal_reward"`
	Task             string  `json:"task"`
}
    Config declares the map, episode rules and task. Width and Height must be
    odd and >= 5; WallDensity in [0, 0.4]; ViewDepth in [1, 5]; TimeLimit >= 1;
    StepPenalty >= 0; CollisionPenalty >= 0; GoalReward > 0; Task is one of
    remember_goal, avoid_obstacles, adapt_after_change, language_goal ("" maps
    to avoid_obstacles). Zero values take the defaults (9x9, 0.2, 3, 60, 0.01,
    0.05, 1). All floating-point fields must be finite.

func (c Config) Resolve() (Config, error)
